gaps: P0–P2: none (the Merian 1661 item is a flat fortification plan); P3 only the lithograph of about 1840
notes: #10: the British Museum dates it only 1830–83; the sheet is headed Le Moyen Âge pittoresque (Veith et Hauser, published 1837–40) and printed by Lemercier, so about 1840. #15 was taken in May 1918 during the German spring offensive, but it shows no damage, so not marked as an event. #1 and #2 are 1918 vertical aerials misdated 1648–49 by their archive numbers. #14 is weak (no cathedral); drop it if a blank plate is preferred.
